_comment: 突變測試（StrykerJS）。預設關閉：不在 npm test 也不在每次 PR 的 CI 裡，手動 `npm run test:mutation` 才跑，或在 GitHub Actions 手動觸發 Mutation 工作流程。只突變純函式邏輯（規則引擎、儲存搬移、雙語工具）；model.ts 幾乎全是內容資料，不列入。 / Mutation testing (StrykerJS). Off by default: not part of npm test or the per-PR CI; run `npm run test:mutation` by hand or trigger the Mutation workflow manually. Only pure logic is mutated (rule engine, storage migration, locale helpers); model.ts is almost all content data and is left out.
